definition: Stefan Schaal (born 1961) is a German-American computer scientist specializing in robotics, machine learning, autonomous systems, and computational neuroscience.
details: Stefan Schaal (born 1961) is a German-American computer scientist specializing in robotics, machine learning, autonomous systems, and computational neuroscience.
story: Picture hiring a brilliant new assistant on their first morning — smart, motivated, but with no idea how anything in your office actually works. It plans a little, acts a little, looks at the result, and then decides what to do next. It is the difference between a search engine and a helper who actually finishes the task. It is a loop of look, act, and learn — the same way you cook from a recipe you have never tried: add, taste, correct. And that habit of checking, acting, then checking again is Stefan Schaal.
